"""Matcher + calibration worst-case microbenchmarks."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from online_matching.match_p4 import Matcher
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import _row_match_masks

rng = random.Random(3)
pool = [v for v in range(0, 3029) if v != 1514]

# 4000 kept patterns, lengths 2..16, intervals covering everything
kept = []
for i in range(4000):
    L = 2 + (i % 15)
    pat = [[0, 3028]] * L
    kept.append((i, i % 2, pat))
t0 = time.time()
m = Matcher(kept)
print('build %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))

feats = [pool[rng.randrange(len(pool))] for _ in range(20000)]
t0 = time.time()
n = 0
for k in range(2, 200002):
    n += 1
    r = m.best(feats, (k % 19990) + 2)
print('200k queries %.2fs (res=%s)' % (time.time()-t0, r))

# calibration: 4096 wide patterns, 8192 rows of 128
clusters = []
for i in range(4096):
    L = 2 + (i % 15)
    clusters.append({'range': [[0, 3028]] * L})
rows = []
for i in range(8192):
    rows.append({'class': i % 2, 'values': [pool[rng.randrange(len(pool))] for _ in range(128)]})
t0 = time.time()
hits = _row_match_masks(clusters, rows, 2)
print('calibration %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0), 'hits[0]=', hits[0])
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp/dev && bash -c 'ulimit -v 1048576; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 bench_matcher.py'
